_notes: Entries here advertise per-model multi-image *input* capability for cloud providers. Schema per entry: {multi_image: bool, max_input_images: int | null}. multi_image=true means the model accepts >1 reference image per request; max_input_images is the cap (null = uncapped or unknown to client; server may still reject excess). The key prefix matches the user's chosen provider_id (typically the preset name 'nanogpt' for the NanoGPT preset). Live extraction from provider metadata is not currently usable for this signal: NanoGPT's supported_parameters.max_images is the output-n cap, not the input cap (see adapter.extract_multi_image_info docstring). The live probe sweep on 2026-05-18 verified N=2 multi-image dispatch for the NanoGPT models below; the cap field is left null because the upper bound was not probed (the probe budgeted for shape verification only). Source cassettes at test/cloud/cassettes/probe/multi_image/nanogpt/.
